verdict.rationale: The Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is a laptop processor (CPU/NPU silicon), so a built-in AI assistant that takes delegated tasks is a category error for this kind of product. The Copilot+ PC positioning describes the host OS and PC platform, not an assistant inside the chip. AI Hub and GenieX are developer tools for building on-device AI, not a shipped assistant, so neither makes the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
